notes.title: Update 1.3.830
notes.notes:
Hello ladies and gentlemen, welcome to the first Goscurry Steam update.

New Features

 Added optional unlocked cities randomization.
On the PLAY panel you have a new option which, if checked, will randomize the order of all the cities you unlocked. The ones that are still locked will keep their order, so this is just a visual candy, and not a way to unlock cities more easily.


Bugfixes

 Fixed Ram and Diver achievements calculating values per mode instead than overall. If you should've got one of these achievements already, starting Goscurry after this update will immediately grant it.

notes.title: Update coming within the week
notes.notes:
An update will come later this week, with a bugfix for the Ram and Diver achievements, which are currently taking into account falls/crashes for individual modes instead than for all of them together. I deeply apologize for this and am working on it.

Other than that, there will be an option to randomize the cities order (only for the ones you unlocked), as suggested by @Hobbes.

PUKE mode is done but won't be in this update, since I want to take more time on it and make it more flashy.

Cheers!
